dct_description_sm: This data set includes underwater light conditions, dissolved and particulate matter, alkalinity, turbidity and chlorophyll a concentrations found in the Mackenzie River in summer.  These measurements were made to study photosynthetic carbon and bacterial fluxes in the river and estuary, and also to give background information on the environment sampled.
dct_title_s: Optical and organic matter characteristics of the Mackenzie River, Beaufort Sea (ARDEX)
